Dawson Gibbs breaks down how he approaches UGC marketing for apps and brands, based on his experience generating billions of views and working across different types of products. He explains how creator selection, hooks, content formats, and messaging should change depending on whether a product relies more on credibility or relatability.

The conversation covers campaigns for travel apps, business marketplaces, shopping platforms, and viral products, including how creator ICPs can affect audience quality and churn. Dawson also explains campaign attribution, creator pages, Instagram Stories, green screen formats, content approval, and how his team identifies videos with early traction and tells creators to repost or recreate them. He closes by explaining why the right audience can matter more than raw view count and why the format is only the vehicle, while the variables inside it determine how the content works.
